speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I promised Mistress Ansell I would give thee her opinion of the forsworn gentlemen. She asked it with the quire still in her hand.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: The widow who notches the loaf. Let us have her opinion, and not a performance of it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Four young men swear off women and keep it till dinner. That she believes. Those were her words.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: Till dinner is a long oath in this house, and a short one on a stage.

speaker: mary_shakespeare
text: She has kept a kitchen. A man with a book still expects the pot to notice him.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: And when they have broken it, do the ladies take them?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No. A messenger comes in black. Her father is dead. The ladies refuse them, and set them a twelvemonth to prove the oath they already broke.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: A twelvemonth is a year and a day in some mouths. Does none of them marry?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Not one. The men go one way and the women another. There is a song at the end, and I am not singing it at this table.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: The ladies were right to make them wait, and a twelvemonth was short.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: What is the year for, if they are not taken?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: One is sent to a quiet house. The pleasant talker is sent to jest among the sick, to see if a dry ear will laugh.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Thou gavest the talker the hard year. That was honest of thee, Will.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will tell Mistress Ansell what thou said, word for word. That the ladies were right to make them wait, and a twelvemonth was short.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Tell her so. We may agree upon a gentleman's oath and never agree upon a playhouse.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: Is there a second play, to show whether they kept the year?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No second play, Susanna. Once the year begins, it is their own business.

speaker: mary_shakespeare
text: That is the wisest of it. Three shirts do a London week, and none of them has come home mended. I am saying the number, not the trade.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A woman at the lodging, when she is asked. I am not asking her from Warwickshire.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: The opinion is thine to take back, brother. I have the bread.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Sit. This is not a packing. Thou hast delivered the opinion. That was the errand.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: Four men, one year, no wedding. I can keep that without the song.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Keep it. I am not writing a line of it in this house.

speaker: mary_shakespeare
text: Then fold thy hands and eat. The number of shirts can sit beside the number of the year, and neither of them is a speech.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: The sentence is said. I am not improving it.
